name: Yasoukyoku
source:
Flamberg Kingdom. Rune was saved by Prince Raphas at a young age and became his servant afterwards. Days pass peacefully since then. But it does not last forever.
"You protect me, I protect you".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
